{{Quote|This is Jedi Knight Tensa Voll|[[Xirossk]]|<ref name="LFC" />}}
'''Tensa Voll''' was a dark-skinned [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who served as a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Tensa Voll received formal [[Jedi training/Legends|instruction]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] at an [[Jedi academy|academy]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Having achieved the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], Jedi Voll was assigned to [[Almas]] where she accepted missions from the [[Almas Academy|enclave's]] governing [[Almas Council|Council]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]]. When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], Voll invoked the [[Right of Denial]] and elected to remain on Almas throughout the war.<ref name="LFC" />

During the war, Voll was selected to join a task force assembled by Academy Headmaster [[Devan For'deschel]] to neutralize the [[Wyrd]] cult prevalent on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. Meeting with [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Xirossk]] of the [[Cularin Militia]], she and her fellow Jedi were aided by the [[Heroes of Cularin]] in their assignment.<ref name="LFC" />
